title: Finite domain algebras have finite fraction-field degree
statement: Let $R\hookrightarrow S$ be an injective homomorphism of commutative integral domains (nonzero rings without zero divisors). Suppose $S$ is a finitely generated $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Then the induced field extension $\operatorname{Frac}(S)/\operatorname{Frac}(R)$ [def-pc-field-extension] is finite-dimensional. Here $\operatorname{Frac}(R)$ consists of quotients $a/b$ with $a,b\in R$, $b\ne0$, and similarly for $S$; the induced map sends $a/b$ to the quotient of their images. No Noetherian or normality hypothesis is imposed.
